text:
Maya (Growth): Quick final decision thread for Jun 18 webinar. Proposal: 50m main (demo + short panel) + 30m parallel labs. Need: breakout content, rehearsal times, promo clips, and lead mapping.

Liz (Speaker Ops): Confirmed. Request: 2 rehearsals (full run + greenroom). Speakers provide 15s social clip + 30s technical blurb. Deadlines: clips + bios by Wed.

Omar (Benchmarks): I'll run a compact live demo showing three quant configs and a tiny cost table. Deliverables: Colab snippet (<8 lines), cost workbook (sheet) and a slide with p50/p95 numbers. No private keys.

Sofie (Demand Gen): Landing form fields: breakout_choice, persona_tag, speaker_follow_up. Map to Marketo list Webinar_Jun18 and SFDC campaign Webinar_Jun18. Email cadence: invite, 48h reminder, 24h reminder, 1h day-of.

Diego (Creative): I'll produce 15s vertical promo + 30s speaker highlight. Also 3 teaser GIFs for socials. Need speaker one-liners by Tue.

Maya (Growth): Run-of-show draft:
00:00-00:05 Intro + poll (breakout picks)
00:05-00:25 Live cost demo (Omar)
00:25-00:55 Breakouts (3 rooms, 20m)
00:55-01:10 Panel + audience Q&A
01:10-01:15 Wrap + CTAs (workbook download + demo request)

Liz (Speaker Ops): Rehearsals: Jun 16 10:00 PT (full run) and Jun 18 09:30 PT (greenroom). GreenroomBot will attach links.

Omar (Benchmarks): Timeline: cost workbook + Colab by Fri EOD; sample slide with numbers by Fri. Will include a tiny emulator for routing demo (no infra required).

Sofie (Demand Gen): Lead webhook: POST /events/webinar-jun18 body: email, company, breakout_choice, persona_tag, interest_level. interest_level values: workbook|demo -> demo = AE hot queue. We'll tag registrants by breakout for nurture.

Diego (Creative): noted. I'll drop assets to drive by Mon.

Maya (Growth): Action items compiled: assets by speakers Wed, Omar deliverables Fri, Diego promos Mon, Sofie setup Marketo flow Tue, Liz send invites + speaker cheat sheet today. Locking format unless objections by EOD.

GreenroomBot: rehearsal events created and invites sent. Reminders scheduled.
